organization_name: Three Realms Mount Rights Protection Association
founded_year: During the Great Tang Zhenguan era
ceo: Former Director of the Heavenly Imperial Stables
mission: Protect the mounts of the Three Realms from demon seizure · advance legislation on mount labor rights

key_findings.title: Class-A war criminals kept as pets
key_findings.description: Demons have long seized Heavenly mounts and kept Class-A war criminals (e.g., the Green Ox Demon and the Nine-Headed Lion) as pets, seriously violating the mounts' autonomy.
implicated_monsters: Green Ox Demon (mount of Taishang Laojun)
Nine-Headed Lion (mount of Taiyi Jiuku Tianzun)

key_findings.title: Forced labor and exploitation
key_findings.description: Mounts were used by demons to patrol mountains, guard gates, and transport plundered goods — with no rest days, no pay, and severely excessive working hours.
implicated_monsters: White Dragon Horse (forced to carry Tang Sanzang at Eagle's Sorrow Gorge)

key_findings.title: Identity theft
key_findings.description: Demons impersonated mounts to infiltrate the mortal world, damaging the mounts' reputation and causing some mounts to be held accountable by Heaven.
implicated_monsters: Yellow-Robed Demon (Kui Mulang of the 28 Mansions descended to earth)
Goldfish Demon (escaped from Guanyin's lotus pond)

key_findings.title: Loss of wages and benefits
key_findings.description: After descending to earth, Heavenly mounts had their wages suspended and social insurance halted; upon returning to Heaven they could not make back payments, affecting their retirement benefits.

key_findings.title: Psychological harm and trauma
key_findings.description: Some mounts were used by demons for improper purposes (such as abducting children or eating people) and required long-term psychological counseling after returning to Heaven.

case_studies.incident: The Green Ox sneaked down to earth while its boy attendant slept, seized a mountain as king, and used the Vajra Ring to collect every weapon.
case_studies.victims: Wukong · the celestial troops and generals · the weapons of many deities
case_studies.resolution: Taishang Laojun came in person and retrieved it with the Banana Leaf Fan
case_studies.compensation_claim: Heaven should bear supervisory responsibility and compensate the harmed mortal commoners.
case_studies.outcome: The Green Ox returned to Heaven and continued as a mount, with no real punishment.

case_studies.incident: The Nine-Headed Lion descended to earth, subdued six lion grandsons, and came into conflict with Yuhua Prefecture.
case_studies.victims: the people of Yuhua Prefecture · Wukong and his master's party
case_studies.resolution: Taiyi Jiuku Tianzun came in person to retrieve it.
case_studies.compensation_claim: The Nine-Headed Lion itself does not eat people, but it tolerated its lion grandsons' misdeeds and should bear joint liability.
case_studies.outcome: The Nine-Headed Lion returned to Heaven; the six lions were beaten to death.

case_studies.incident: The Golden-Haired Hou descended to earth as a demon, abducted the queen of the Zhuzi Kingdom, and stayed away for three years.
case_studies.victims: the queen of the Zhuzi Kingdom · the people of the Zhuzi Kingdom
case_studies.resolution: Guanyin came in person to retrieve it.
case_studies.compensation_claim: Guanyin should bear responsibility for lax discipline, and the Zhuzi Kingdom should receive state compensation.
case_studies.outcome: The Golden-Haired Hou returned to the South Sea and continued as a mount, with no real punishment.

case_studies.original_owner: Dragon King of the Western Sea (its father)
case_studies.incident: The third prince of the Western Sea Dragon King was demoted for setting fire to the palace's bright pearl and was transformed into a white horse to carry Tang Sanzang for 14 years.
case_studies.resolution: Ultimately became one of the Eight Classes of Divine Beings and attained a Bodhisattva rank.
case_studies.compensation_claim: The White Dragon Horse is one of the few voluntary mounts, but after 14 years without pay it should receive back wages.
case_studies.outcome: The White Dragon Horse was granted the rank of the Eight Classes of Divine Beings and restored to dragon form.

recommendations: Heaven should establish a mount archive system recording each mount's descents and returns.
Mount descents should be filed in advance, and mounts should wear GPS tracking devices.
During a mount's descent, wages should continue and social insurance should keep being paid.
For damages caused by demons impersonating mounts, Heaven should compensate first and then seek recovery from the demons.
Establish a mount psychological counseling mechanism, with mandatory psychological assessment after returning to Heaven.
